purpose: Minimum buildable source-guided geometry candidates for two source-supported role variants. This is not a historical metric reconstruction.

coordinate_system.x: support-span direction in the transverse section

scaling_policy.rule: Do not convert normalized dimensions into historical millimetres. At assembly time, derive a replaceable production envelope from neighboring locked components / support interfaces.

variants.evidence_role: 四椽栿上用驼峰、令栱承平梁
variants.evidence_geometry_strength: LOW / ROLE DIRECT, ISOLATED PROFILE NOT DIRECTLY LOCKED
variants.modeling_note: Conservative stacked support envelope. No curved historical profile is claimed because the lower-role 驼峰 is not isolated by a metric/source-labeled drawing.

variants.evidence_role: 平梁之上设驼峰、蜀柱、叉手
variants.evidence_geometry_strength: MEDIUM / ROLE DIRECT + SAME-BUILDING FIG 2-71 VISUAL
variants.modeling_note: Profile is a deliberately simplified stepped abstraction of the low mound/raised support visible beneath the central short post in same-building Fig. 2-71. Control points are normalized reconstruction coordinates, not measured historic dimensions.

acceptance_questions: Does the LOWER_SUPPORT candidate remain sufficiently neutral without implying an unsupported historical profile?
Does the UPPER_RIDGE_SUPPORT candidate preserve the source-visible broad-base / raised-center character without claiming metric accuracy?
Can both candidates be assembly-scaled later without changing component identity or relationship semantics?
